query:
SELECT cr.id as "id!"
            FROM capture_runs cr
            LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
                SELECT GREATEST(
                    MAX(cri.started_at),
                    MAX(cri.completed_at)
                ) AS last_activity
                FROM capture_run_items cri
                WHERE cri.run_id = cr.id
            ) activity ON TRUE
            WHERE cr.status = 'running'
              AND COALESCE(activity.last_activity, cr.started_at)
                  < now() - make_interval(secs => $1::float8)
